observations.text: Official manual: PRC-41 contains exactly four ordered transitions, stages 1 through 4; each stage output becomes the next stage input.
In PRC-41 stage 1, RAV-65 changes into GOL-90.
In PRC-41 stage 2, GOL-90 changes into ZUM-54.
In PRC-41 stage 4, BEX-66 changes into terminal marker LUM-28.

In PRC-45 stage 2, BIR-91 changes into WIR-16.
In PRC-45 stage 4, KEL-77 changes into terminal marker ZIR-63.
Official manual: PRC-21 contains exactly four ordered transitions, stages 1 through 4; each stage output becomes the next stage input.
In PRC-21 stage 1, JOT-61 changes into ZIR-49.
In PRC-21 stage 2, ZIR-49 changes into JOT-25.
In PRC-21 stage 4, JOT-37 changes into terminal marker TEK-77.
